lines.t: Hook:
Heart tucked, belt struck, little boy, no trust, just rust in the cut, yeah
Action flicks, no hugs, just guns, no love, just blood when it’s rough, yeah
Now I ride with the King, YahuShua in the whip, bring the pain to the light, no bluff, yeah
Cast weights, break chains, bring wounds to His name, get crushed in His love, that’s tough, yeah[verse]
